@staticmethod
    def get_empresas(usuario_id):
        """
        Devuelve el alcance efectivo de empresas.

        Conserva las asignaciones explicitas y agrega empresas derivadas
        exclusivamente desde el mismo scope canonico servidor/sucursal que
        resuelve unidades. No infiere por nombres, aliases ni MongoDB.

        Politica:
        - servidor con una sola unidad activa: la asignacion del servidor o
          de su sucursal puede proyectar la empresa canonica del servidor;
        - servidor compartido: exige sucursal exacta y toma la EmpresaID de
          Sistema_Sucursales;
        - relaciones incompletas no conceden empresa.
        """
        return fetch_all_dict("""
            WITH UnitBase AS (
                SELECT
                    TRY_CONVERT(
                        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
                        u.server_id
                    ) AS ServidorID,
                    NULLIF(
                        LTRIM(RTRIM(
                            TRY_CONVERT(
                                NVARCHAR(100),
                                u.sucursal_origen_id
                            )
                        )),
                        ''
                    ) AS SucursalOrigenID,
                    COUNT_BIG(*) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY u.server_id
                    ) AS ActiveUnitsOnServer
                FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio AS u
                WHERE ISNULL(u.activo, 0) = 1
            ),
            ActiveUnits AS (
                SELECT
                    ub.ServidorID,
                    ub.SucursalOrigenID,
                    ub.ActiveUnitsOnServer,
                    s.EmpresaID AS ServerEmpresaID,
                    ss.EmpresaID AS BranchEmpresaID
                FROM UnitBase AS ub
                INNER JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones AS s
                    ON s.id = ub.ServidorID
                   AND ISNULL(s.activo, 1) = 1
                LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo AS sm
                    ON sm.ServidorID = s.id
                   AND ISNULL(sm.Activo, 1) = 1
                   AND ub.SucursalOrigenID IS NOT NULL
                   AND UPPER(
                        LTRIM(RTRIM(
                            ISNULL(sm.SucursalOrigenID, '')
                        ))
                   ) = UPPER(
                        LTRIM(RTRIM(
                            ub.SucursalOrigenID
                        ))
                   )
                LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Sucursales AS ss
                    ON ss.SucursalID = sm.SucursalID
                   AND ISNULL(ss.Activo, 1) = 1
            ),
            ExplicitScope AS (
                SELECT
                    usa.UsuarioID,
                    usa.ServidorID,
                    CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS SucursalCodigo,
                    CAST('SERVER' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ScopeType
                FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa
                WHERE usa.UsuarioID = %s
                  AND ISNULL(usa.Activo, 1) = 1

                UNION ALL

                SELECT
                    usa.UsuarioID,
                    usa.ServidorID,
                    NULLIF(
                        LTRIM(RTRIM(
                            TRY_CONVERT(
                                NVARCHAR(100),
                                usa.SucursalCodigo
                            )
                        )),
                        ''
                    ) AS SucursalCodigo,
                    CAST('BRANCH' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ScopeType
                FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion AS usa
                WHERE usa.UsuarioID = %s
                  AND ISNULL(usa.Activo, 1) = 1
            ),
            DerivedCompanies AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    CASE
                        WHEN au.ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
                            THEN au.BranchEmpresaID
                        ELSE COALESCE(
                            au.BranchEmpresaID,
                            au.ServerEmpresaID
                        )
                    END AS EmpresaID
                FROM ActiveUnits AS au
                INNER JOIN ExplicitScope AS es
                    ON es.ServidorID = au.ServidorID
                   AND (
                        au.ActiveUnitsOnServer = 1
                        OR (
                            au.ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
                            AND es.ScopeType = 'BRANCH'
                            AND au.SucursalOrigenID IS NOT NULL
                            AND es.SucursalCodigo IS NOT NULL
                            AND UPPER(
                                LTRIM(RTRIM(
                                    au.SucursalOrigenID
                                ))
                            ) = UPPER(
                                LTRIM(RTRIM(
                                    es.SucursalCodigo
                                ))
                            )
                        )
                   )
            ),
            ExplicitCompanies AS (
                SELECT EmpresaID
                FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion
                WHERE UsuarioID = %s
                  AND ISNULL(Activo, 1) = 1
            )
            SELECT DISTINCT EmpresaID
            FROM (
                SELECT EmpresaID
                FROM ExplicitCompanies

                UNION ALL

                SELECT EmpresaID
                FROM DerivedCompanies
            ) AS EffectiveCompanies
            WHERE EmpresaID IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY EmpresaID
        """, [usuario_id, usuario_id, usuario_id])

from core.rbac_sql import service as service_module
from core.rbac_sql.service import RBACSQLService


def test_get_empresas_uses_canonical_server_branch_scope(monkeypatch):
    captured = {}

    def fake_fetch_all(sql, params):
        captured["sql"] = sql
        captured["params"] = params
        return [{"EmpresaID": 2}, {"EmpresaID": 5}]

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        service_module,
        "fetch_all_dict",
        fake_fetch_all,
    )

    result = RBACSQLService.get_empresas(9)

    assert result == [
        {"EmpresaID": 2},
        {"EmpresaID": 5},
    ]
    assert captured["params"] == [9, 9, 9]

    sql = captured["sql"]
    assert "Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion" in sql
    assert "Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion" in sql
    assert "Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion" in sql
    assert "Unidades_Negocio" in sql
    assert "Servidores_Conexiones" in sql
    assert "Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo" in sql
    assert "Sistema_Sucursales" in sql
    assert "ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1" in sql
    assert "SucursalCodigo" in sql
    assert "EmpresaID IS NOT NULL" in sql


def test_get_empresas_does_not_use_legacy_mongo_mapping(monkeypatch):
    captured = {}

    def fake_fetch_all(sql, params):
        captured["sql"] = sql
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        service_module,
        "fetch_all_dict",
        fake_fetch_all,
    )

    assert RBACSQLService.get_empresas(28) == []

    assert "Sistema_EmpresasMongoMap" not in captured["sql"]
    assert "MongoUUID" not in captured["sql"]


def test_can_access_empresa_uses_effective_company_scope(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "_has_superadmin_role",
        staticmethod(lambda usuario_id: False),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "get_empresas",
        staticmethod(
            lambda usuario_id: [
                {"EmpresaID": 2},
                {"EmpresaID": 5},
            ]
        ),
    )

    assert RBACSQLService.can_access_empresa(9, 2) is True
    assert RBACSQLService.can_access_empresa(9, 5) is True
    assert RBACSQLService.can_access_empresa(9, 4) is False


def test_can_access_empresa_keeps_superadmin_rule(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "_has_superadmin_role",
        staticmethod(lambda usuario_id: True),
    )

    assert RBACSQLService.can_access_empresa(3, 5) is True
